item.title: An inside look of the massive data center tearing a Wisconsin community apart
item.description: In Port Washington, Wisconsin, there's a data center being built that's as big as 500 football fields. Residents aren't sure if it could save their community or destroy it.

item.title: New Colorado library helps people check out nature, not just books.
item.description: A new library in Colorado helps people check out nature, not just books. Library cards give free access to camping gear, nature trails and outdoor experiences.

item.description: NPR's Brianna Scott and Gabriel Sanchez explain why they love the films that scare them, and have some tips for Halloween watching.

item.title: Why Wisconsin's tight governor's race matters
item.description: The close race for governor in Wisconsin is being watched to see how a candidate back by President Trump does in a state where rural voters have sometimes swung from one party the other.

item.title: U.S. measles cases more than double what they were last year as outbreak spreads
item.description: Pennsylvania is the worst hit state, with at least 1,338 cases of measles confirmed in 44 counties so far this year, according to the Pennsylvania Department of Health.
